name: Franky
description: Manga-through-Wano Franky is a cola-fueled cyborg shipwright with built-in guns, chain fists, compressed air and beams. BF-37 is a gameplay alternate form. General Franky, the Thousand Sunny, utility feats and back vulnerability are omitted; values are adaptations.

paths.name: Iron Arsenal
paths.description: Improves Franky's built-in guns, ammunition and destructive output. The emission upgrade abstracts a straight-line shoulder missile burst rather than simulating individual missile trajectories.

upgrades.name: Wrist Gun Feed
upgrades.description: Adds heavier ammunition to the ordinary primary gun attack.

upgrades.name: Rapid Cycling
upgrades.description: Improves the firing mechanism and shortens primary attack timing.

upgrades.name: Impact Ammunition
upgrades.description: Increases damage from Franky's ordinary and technique weapon systems.

upgrades.name: Weak-Point Calibration
upgrades.description: Franky's marksmanship adaptation lets ordinary damage partially ignore armor.

upgrades.name: Shoulder Missile Emission
upgrades.description: Every third successful primary contact emits a straight burst away from Franky with separate damage and a target cap.

paths.name: Cola Pressure
paths.description: Builds the cola-powered pressure systems behind Franky's chain fist and compressed-air attacks. Stamina and drain values are gameplay adaptations, not measured canon fuel limits.

upgrades.name: Long-Arm Chain
upgrades.description: Extends the effective reach of Franky's gun and chain-fist attacks.

upgrades.name: Cola Pressure
upgrades.description: Higher pressure increases the damage of powered cyborg attacks.

upgrades.name: Heavy Iron Fist
upgrades.description: Strengthens Strong Right and other direct-impact adaptations.

upgrades.name: Pressure Recovery
upgrades.description: Improves the reset cycle of Franky's cola-driven mechanisms, shortening primary timing.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Pressure Chambers
upgrades.description: Adds a second damage increase to compressed-air and other powered cyborg attacks.

paths.name: Shipwright Tactics
paths.description: Uses Franky's engineering, weak-point targeting and battlefield improvisation. Detection is a gameplay adaptation of tactical awareness, not a claim of universal source-defined sensors.

upgrades.name: Tactical Weak-Point Readout
upgrades.description: Enables primary acquisition against concealed targets.

upgrades.name: Chain Retrieval Protocol
upgrades.description: Allows a lost ordinary primary target to be replaced at resolution without restarting its windup.

upgrades.name: Extended Weapon Rails
upgrades.description: Adds reach to Franky's built-in artillery and powered attacks.

upgrades.name: Vegapunk Cycle Control
upgrades.description: Refines the post-timeskip mechanisms to shorten primary timing.

upgrades.name: Super Armament Frame
upgrades.description: Adds a final broad damage increase to the cyborg's ordinary weapon systems.
